title: Declared event RateUpdated is never emitted
rootCause: The event `RateUpdated(uint256 newRate, uint256 newBalance)` is declared but never emitted in this contract. `rewardPerSecond` is recomputed in `_updatePool`, `collectReward`, and `setDepletionDuration` -- all of which would have been natural emission sites. `collectReward` emits `RewardCollected(amount, newBalance, newRate)` which carries the same information for that one path; `_updatePool` and `setDepletionDuration` emit nothing on rate change.
impact: Off-chain rate monitoring is incomplete. Combined with CODE-001 (the rate is re-anchored on every interaction), there is no event trail letting integrators or auditors track the actual rate trajectory without recomputing it from `rewardBalance` snapshots. The dead declaration is also a code-quality signal.
steps: Inspect the contract: grep 'emit RateUpdated' returns no matches.
_updatePool changes rewardPerSecond on every accrual but emits no event.
Integrators cannot observe rate changes between RewardCollected events.
remediation: Either remove the unused event or emit it from `_updatePool`'s rate-change branch and from `setDepletionDuration` after the recompute.
profileReference: Profile §11 Complexity / Surface Metrics: 'RateUpdated is declared but never emitted -- flag QA.'
